people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: Of the Levites, certain divisions in Judah settled in Benjamin’s territory.
translations.bsb: And some divisions of the Levites of Judah settled in Benjamin.
translations.kjv: And of the Levites were divisions in Judah, and in Benjamin.
translations.asv: And of the Levites, certain courses in Judah were joined to Benjamin.
